literal_meaning: ঢাক বাজিয়ে কিছু ঢেকে রাখা (playing the drum to cover and keep something hidden)
figurative_meaning_en: Attempting to cover up faults or mistakes through loud publicity or fanfare
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার অপরাধ ঢাক বাজিয়ে ঢেকে রাখার চেষ্টা করছে।
প্রশাসন দুর্নীতির ঘটনা ঢাক বাজিয়ে ঢেকে রাখতে চায়।
example_sentences_in_english: He is trying to cover up his crime by making a lot of noise elsewhere.
The administration wants to hide the corruption scandal with high-profile announcements.
note: This idiom draws from traditional Bengali imagery of using loud drum sounds to mask or distract from underlying issues.
